FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'Goodbye, Sir.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je m'appelle Njeri.
   B. Au revoir, Monsieur.
   C. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   D. Ça va bien, merci.

2. How do you say 'Hi, Kamau!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Comment tu t'appelles ?
   B. Oui, ça va.
   C. Bonsoir, Madame !
   D. Salut, Kamau !

3. Read: Voici ma maison. Il y a une cuisine, un salon et deux chambres. Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télé. Question: What is in the living room? (1 mark)
   A. a sofa and a TV
   B. a rug only
   C. a bed
   D. a fridge

4. What does 'la table' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the kitchen
   B. the bedroom
   C. the table
   D. the chair

5. How do you say 'The ball is behind the door.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mets le livre sur la table.
   B. Le ballon est derrière la porte.
   C. C'est une table.
   D. Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.

6. What does 'demain' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomorrow
   B. I rest
   C. I dance
   D. I play

7. What does 'l'église' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the week
   B. the school
   C. the day
   D. the church

8. What number is 'cinq' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 18
   C. 7
   D. 5

9. What number is 'onze' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 21
   C. 30
   D. 11

10. Which month is 'septembre'? (1 mark)
   A. November
   B. March
   C. September
   D. May

11. What does 'la tomate' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. rice
   B. the tomato
   C. water
   D. bread

12. What does 'la main' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the hand
   B. the eyes
   C. the leg
   D. the nose

13. What does 'noir' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. black
   B. long
   C. tall, big
   D. short

14. How do you say 'It is on the table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. La télé est sur la table.
   B. Il est sur la table.
   C. Elle est sous la chaise.
   D. Où est la clé ?

15. How do you say 'The door is next to the window.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le chat est derrière la porte.
   B. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   C. La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.
   D. La télé est sur la table.

16. How do you say 'The TV is on the table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. La télé est sur la table.
   B. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   C. La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.
   D. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?

17. What does 'Salut, Kamau !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. How do you spell it?
   B. Hi, Kamau!
   C. Yes, I am fine.
   D. Good evening, Madam!

18. Which little word goes with 'garçon' (the boy)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. les

19. What does 'C'est mon père.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my grandmother.
   B. Here is my family.
   C. Who is it?
   D. This is my father.

20. Which little word goes with 'livre' (the book)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. les

21. What does 'Il y a un canapé dans le salon.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The TV is in the living room.
   B. The rug is in front of the sofa.
   C. There is a sofa in the living room.
   D. It is a table.

22. Read: Salut ! Je m'appelle Kamau. J'ai dix ans. Le samedi, je joue au football. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église avec ma famille. Question: Who does he go to church with on Sunday? (1 mark)
   A. his cat
   B. nobody
   C. his family
   D. his teacher

23. Which food is good for your health? (1 mark)
   A. les chips
   B. l'eau
   C. les frites
   D. les bonbons

24. Fill in: Je ______ une mangue. (I eat) (1 mark)
   A. mange
   B. joue
   C. bois
   D. danse

25. Fill in: Il est ______. (tall) (1 mark)
   A. longue
   B. petite
   C. grande
   D. grand

26. Read: Quand il y a un orage, je reste dans la maison. Je ne vais pas sous un grand arbre. Quand il fait très chaud, je bois de l'eau. Question: Where does the speaker stay in a storm? (1 mark)
   A. at school
   B. in the garden
   C. under a tree
   D. in the house

27. What does 'Il y a des nuages.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is snowing.
   B. It is raining.
   C. It is windy.
   D. It is cloudy.

28. Which little word goes with 'temps' (the weather)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. l'
   C. les
   D. la

29. What does 'Allez tout droit.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   B. The rug is under the table.
   C. Excuse me, where is the school?
   D. Go straight ahead.

30. How do you say 'How are you?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   B. Ça va ?
   C. Et toi ?
   D. Comment tu t'appelles ?

31. How do you say 'the grandfather' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le grand-père
   B. le frère
   C. le garçon
   D. l'enfant

32. Fill in: ______ grand-père s'appelle David. (1 mark)
   A. La
   B. Ma
   C. Une
   D. Mon

33. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'grandmother'? (1 mark)
   A. gran-mère
   B. grand-mère
   C. grand-mére
   D. grand-mere

34. How do you say 'between' in French? (1 mark)
   A. entre
   B. sur
   C. derrière
   D. dans

35. How do you write the number 3 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trente
   B. trois
   C. dix-neuf
   D. onze

36. How do you say 'a song' in French? (1 mark)
   A. une chanson
   B. un cadeau
   C. une bougie
   D. un anniversaire

37. How do you say 'the orange' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pain
   B. le gâteau
   C. l'orange
   D. la carotte

38. How do you say 'cheese' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le fromage
   B. les frites
   C. la banane
   D. l'eau

39. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'head'? (1 mark)
   A. tete
   B. te´te
   C. têe
   D. tête

40. How do you say 'the foot' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pied
   B. le genou
   C. le bras
   D. la bouche

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. List three tips for reading French aloud clearly. (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'La télé est dans le salon.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'Pleased to meet you!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'Today it is raining.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'What is your name?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'This is my father.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'I am nine years old.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'Today it is Monday.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into English: 'Qu'est-ce que c'est ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into French: 'You are welcome!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

51. Translate into French: 'Tomorrow the weather is nice.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Translate into English: 'Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into English: 'Une semaine, sept jours.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Translate into English: 'Le matin, je mange du pain.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

55. Write the French words for: a song, a balloon, a party (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Translate into French: 'My sister is called Njeri.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into English: 'Voici ma maison.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Write and read aloud a short greeting for a card to a girl called Njeri. Write what you would say. (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Translate into English: 'Ce sont des mangues.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into French: 'The TV is in the living room.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

61. Translate into English: 'Je m'appelle Njeri.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

62. Translate into English: 'Il y a des nuages.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

63. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux yeux.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4 · MARKING SCHEME

SECTION A
----
1. B — Au revoir, Monsieur.
   Goodbye, Sir. in French is Au revoir, Monsieur.

2. D — Salut, Kamau !
   Hi, Kamau! in French is Salut, Kamau !

3. A — a sofa and a TV
   Un canapé et une télé.

4. C — the table
   la table means the table.

5. B — Le ballon est derrière la porte.
   The ball is behind the door. in French is Le ballon est derrière la porte.

6. A — tomorrow

7. D — the church
   l'église means the church.

9. D — 11

10. C — September

11. B — the tomato
   la tomate means the tomato.

12. A — the hand
   la main means the hand.

13. A — black
   noir means black.

14. B — Il est sur la table.

17. B — Hi, Kamau!

18. C — le
   garçon is masculine, so we say le garçon.

19. D — This is my father.

20. B — le

35. B — trois

36. A — une chanson

37. C — l'orange

38. A — le fromage
   cheese in French is le fromage.

39. D — tête
   The correct spelling is tête, with its accents.

40. A — le pied
   the foot in French is le pied.
